program.name: Bar EMOM and Pairs
program.subject: Pull-ups
program.blurb: A pull-up EMOM, then full-body supersets.
program.about: Pull-ups on the clock, then everything else in pairs. Each day opens with an EMOM of two bar moves, a set at the top of every minute, then two supersets of legs, a press and a row. Two days alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II slows every rep down and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Bar EMOM, then supersets, A / B
